title: Drupal Fixes Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities
excerpt: Drupal has released security updates to patch two critical remote code execution flaws affecting all supported versions of the CMS.
body_html:
Drupal has released security patches to address two critical vulnerabilities impacting websites running any supported version of the content management system. These security flaws could potentially allow attackers to execute code remotely.

Following the release of the patches, warnings have been issued that malicious exploits targeting these vulnerabilities might emerge soon. Website administrators and operators utilizing the platform are advised to apply the necessary updates promptly to protect their systems from potential attacks.
